games.description: Co-op escape rooms with Bruce Greene and Diction. The trio works through the Egyptian chambers’ scales, skulls, bowls, and statues, then repairs the stranded spacecraft’s emergency systems and drone.
games.title: Escape Simulator

games.description: A brief multiplayer arena test with Diction, Bruce Greene and APL Fisher. Sark tries the public lobby and NPC waves, then spends much of the session trapped in a free-camera spectator state while watching the battles.
games.title: Gladio and Glory

games.description: Eight recorded visits to the roguelite shooter, mixing solo and co-op runs. Sark experiments with weapons and character builds, tackles bosses and daily challenges, and returns for the later classes and Reincarnation difficulty, ending the latest visit with a boss victory that unlocks Reincarnation Four.
games.title: Gunfire Reborn

games.description: Three attempts to investigate Nessie: the first with Bruce and Diction, a solo recon visit, and a later return with Bruce and NFEN. Rowing, equipment handling, failed evidence searches and the pocket Pong game repeatedly get in the way.
games.title: Loch Ness

games.description: Sark's Poppy Playtime archive preserves his first Chapter 1 run, the Atlas-promised Chapters 1-3 marathon, and the two-stream Chapter 4 continuation through Safe Haven, including the increasingly serious Lemon carry.
games.title: Poppy Playtime

games.description: Sark hunts supernatural creatures through Long Wind Valley, Chernobyl Forest and a later castle-area map. Totems, traps, wildlife and healing plants support long searches and repeated battles across four visits.
games.title: Skinwalker Hunt
